configurations.name: matematica-visual
runtimeArgs: const http=require('http'),fs=require('fs'),path=require('path');const types={'.html':'text/html; charset=utf-8','.js':'text/javascript; charset=utf-8','.css':'text/css; charset=utf-8','.json':'application/json','.svg':'image/svg+xml'};http.createServer((req,res)=>{let p=decodeURIComponent(new URL(req.url,'http://x').pathname);if(p.endsWith('/'))p+='index.html';const f=path.join(process.cwd(),p);fs.readFile(f,(e,d)=>{if(e){res.writeHead(404,{'Content-Type':'text/plain'});res.end('404 '+p);return;}res.writeHead(200,{'Content-Type':types[path.extname(f)]||'application/octet-stream'});res.end(d);});}).listen(4173,()=>console.log('Servidor en http://localhost:4173'));
